operations.name: health
operations.description: Liveness check (PocketBase built-in).

operations.name: ops.list
operations.description: Return this operations manifest.

operations.name: notes.list
operations.description: List notes, newest first, with summary, status and open action count. Filters combine.

q.description: Search title, overview, summary, transcript, my notes and attendees.

category.description: Exact category, e.g. Meeting, Interview, Lecture.

operations.name: notes.get
operations.description: One note in full: summary, key points, decisions, action items (with ids), attendees, my notes, transcript and timed segments (each with its speaker once detected: Person 1, Person 2, ...), plus pipeline status (live = recording now, finishing = transcribing its last seconds). peak_db at -91 means the audio is pure silence (nothing was recorded).

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

operations.name: notes.create
operations.description: Create a note from text (no audio), e.g. a pasted meeting transcript. With a transcript, CraftBot's AI writes the summary, key points, decisions and action items in the background.

title.description: Title. Omitted = a dated placeholder the AI replaces.

date.description: Date of the meeting, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

transcript.description: Transcript text to take notes from.

my_notes.description: The user's own notes; never overwritten.

attendees.description: JSON list of names, e.g. ["Sarah Chen","Marcus Lee"].

generate.description: Write AI notes from the transcript (default true).

operations.name: notes.import-audio
operations.description: Import an audio or video file from a local path as a new note. It is transcribed on this PC (Whisper), then CraftBot's AI writes the notes. Poll notes.get or engine.status for progress.

path.description: Absolute path to the file (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, webm, flac, mp4, mov, mkv, ...).

title.description: Title. Omitted = file name, replaced by the AI's title.

date.description: Date of the recording, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

language.description: Spoken language code (en, ja, zh, ...) or auto (default).

operations.name: notes.update
operations.description: Edit a note's fields. Only the params given change. Setting title stops the AI from renaming the note.

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

attendees.description: JSON list of names (replaces the list; names taken off are not re-added by recognition).

key_points.description: JSON list of strings (replaces the list).

decisions.description: JSON list of strings (replaces the list).

language.description: Spoken language for the next transcription: code or auto.

action_items.description: JSON list of {id, title, assignee, due, done} (replaces the list).

transcript.description: Transcript text (only for notes without timed segments).

operations.name: notes.delete
operations.description: Delete a note with its audio and transcript. Stops its transcription if running.

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

operations.name: notes.duplicate
operations.description: Copy a note, including its audio file, transcript and notes.

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

operations.name: notes.transcribe
operations.description: Transcribe (or re-transcribe) a note's audio on this PC. The current transcript stays until the new one is ready. Notes are written automatically only when the note has none yet; otherwise run notes.generate.

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

language.description: Spoken language code (en, ja, zh, ...) or auto. Omitted = the note's setting.

operations.name: notes.generate
operations.description: Have CraftBot's AI (re)write the note from its transcript: overview, summary, key points, decisions, action items, and the title while it is automatic. Replaces those fields; attendees and my_notes are kept.

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

operations.name: notes.attach-audio
operations.description: Attach an audio file to an existing note and transcribe it (multipart upload with an "audio" file; used by the app). To add a file from disk as a new note use notes.import-audio.

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

operations.name: notes.finish-live
operations.description: Finish a recording whose page stopped while recording (status live): transcribe the pieces already received, then write the notes. The app's own Stop button does this and also attaches the audio file.

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

operations.name: notes.detect-people
operations.description: Tell the speakers of a recorded note apart by their voices (local speaker engine, no names guessed): each transcript segment gets its speaker (Person 1, Person 2, ... in order of first speech) and the attendees gain every speaker, including ones removed before. Runs by itself after every transcription; use this to redo it, or with speakers=N when the number of people is known and the detection got it wrong. Poll notes.get people_status (people_error says why a run failed).

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

speakers.description: How many people speak (1-20), kept for later runs; 0 = detect the number. Omit to keep the current setting.

operations.name: notes.rename-speaker
operations.description: Rename a speaker (e.g. Person 1) or attendee everywhere in a note: the transcript lines they speak, the attendees, and action items assigned to them. A detected voice keeps the name through later speaker detections. Renaming to another speaker's name merges the two (fixes one voice detected as two people).

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

speaker.description: The current name, exactly as shown (e.g. "Person 1").

operations.name: notes.cancel
operations.description: Cancel a note's queued or running transcription / note writing. The note keeps whatever it already had.

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

operations.name: notes.export
operations.description: Export a note as text: md (full note), txt (timestamped transcript) or srt (subtitles). Returns {filename, mime, content}.

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

operations.name: actions.add
operations.description: Add an action item to a note.

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

operations.name: actions.update
operations.description: Edit or complete an action item (ids come from notes.get or actions.open).

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

operations.name: actions.delete
operations.description: Remove an action item from a note.

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

operations.name: actions.clear-done
operations.description: Remove a note's completed action items.

note_id.description: Note id, or the note's exact title.

operations.name: actions.open
operations.description: Every open action item across all notes, soonest due first.

assignee.description: Only items for this person (exact name, any case).

operations.name: digest.week
operations.description: Weekly digest (Monday to Sunday): totals, each note's summary, decisions and action items, plus a ready-to-share markdown version.

week.description: Any date in the week, YYYY-MM-DD (default this week).

operations.name: engine.status
operations.description: Speech engine: installed or missing files, the first-run download (setup: state ready|pending|off|downloading|installing|failed, bytes done/total, error), the running job with progress percent, and queue sizes.

operations.name: engine.install
operations.description: Download the speech engine (~410 MB, once) from its official sources into the app's engine folder, checking every file's SHA-256; starts by itself on a fresh install, so use this to retry after a failed download. Returns the setup status; follow engine.status.
